title: SILENCE ONE — "On Mute"
concept: Premise: "What if instead of presenting your product like this... you presented it like THIS." The cheap ad is NOISE. SILENCE ONE's adaptive noise cancelling is the film's one recurring visual device: the ANC RING, a hairline champagne-gold circle that turns noise into silence wherever it passes. It erases the PowerPoint ad (b12), is drawn by the gold period of "THIS." to become the ear cup's ring (b19), calms the sound sea (b20.5), freezes the exploding product mid-air (b36.25), erases the hero lockup into LUMARC navy (b70) and finally becomes the halo of the LUMARC logo (b72-73). The edit follows the tagline. "Hear nothing." is restraint: hairline serif type, real digital silence, frozen time. "Feel everything." is maximalism: the grid multiplying to 128 cells, a product spinning four turns while 256 noise words bury it, cups clamping and crushing the word NOISE, a frozen explosion, a 360-degree gyroscope of 3D type, a spiralling corridor of headphones, 150k particles. ARC: BEFORE (b0-11) cheap slide -> BREAK (b11-16) scratch, crack, the ANC ring erases the slide while the muzak is low-passed to exact zero -> THIS. (b16) slam; letters become windows, then shear away and only the gold period survives, which draws the ear-cup ring -> REVEAL (b20) over a turbulent sound sea that the ring calms, with light-sweep cuts -> DROP 1 (b24) the frame subdivides 1 to 128 cells of photoreal orbit frames, then a Droste dive into the live 3D model -> THE NOISE (b28) 4 accelerating turns under a doubling word storm, then the noise pushes the cups apart and they CLAMP and crush it -> THE MUTE (b36) the product detonates, the ANC ring freezes the explosion, the dB counter dives 118 to -42 on 1/16 steps while the music and the post FX step down to exact silence; 1.0 s of real silence while only the camera drifts through the suspended parts; rewind-snap -> DROP 2 (b40) 360-degree type gyroscope with the music panning around the listener -> GATE RUN (b48) a spiralling corridor of headphones, one gate per beat, tuned whooshes climbing the D-minor scale, slot-machine specs -> PEAK (b56) particle bloom and an accelerating cut cascade -> "Hear nothing." (b62) with the whole score muffled as if noise-cancelled -> "Feel everything." (b64) the filter rips open on the D-MAJOR hero lockup -> HANDOFF (b70-76) the last ANC ring turns into the LUMARC gradient, sheds particles that land as the "lumarc" wordmark letter by letter -> LUMARC END CARD (b76-86). GLOBAL RULES: 150 BPM, beat b starts at b*0.4 s = frame 12b; total 86 beats = 34.4 s = 1032 frames, 1080x1920, 30 fps. The AFTER bar grid is anchored on the THIS. hit: downbeats at 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48, 52, 56, 60, 64, 68, 72, 76, 80, 84, and every major hit lands on one. All motion is a pure function of t (seeded rnd, closed-form easing); no render is ever cached from another t (freezes and snapshots are recomputed per frame). Key copy inside x 80-1000, y 220-1640, no text below 30 px. Only bundled fonts and weights. motionBlur at most 4. No copy anywhere says how the film was made.

scenes.name: BEFORE — the PowerPoint ad

scenes.implementationNotes: Pure 2D, cutIn 'none'. Export (or copy verbatim into s02) renderBefore(ctx, beat): it must reproduce any beat deterministically. Pre-render static slide backgrounds in init. Star mask: build a 10-vertex polygon path and ctx.clip(). WordArt via letters() with per-letter y offsets. Sparkle positions from rnd(i). No Math.random. Text sizes on the cheap slide are deliberately loud; nothing under 46 px.

scenes.name: BREAK — the noise-cancelled ad
scenes.layers: bg2d: the remapped/frozen BEFORE slide (redrawn every frame via renderBefore), then ink #050506. fg2d: crack lines, the gold ANC ring with its refraction band and riding HUD label, the narrator line, the final gold point. 3D: off.
scenes.visual:
- b11.0-11.33 (f132-135) RECORD SCRATCH: the slide jerks horizontally +38, -30, +18, 0 px (one offset per frame) with a 1-frame RGB split; the '50% OFF' blink freezes ON.
- b11.0-11.75 (f132-141) TAPE STOP: the slide keeps animating but its clock slows to zero: beatLocal = 11.0 + 0.375 x (1-(1-u)^2), u = seg(beat, 11, 11.75); the WordArt wave and photo zoom grind to a stop. The frame sags: scale 1 -> .985 about (540,960), +14 px down, saturation 1 -> .3, brightness 1 -> .9 (eio). 2-frame glitch slices at b11.0 and b11.5. From b11.75 the slide is frozen at beatLocal 11.375 (recomputed per frame, never cached across t).
- b11.75 (f141) GLASS CRACK: a spider-web cracks from the ear cup of the frozen slide-2 photo (measure the cup on the placed photo; default (540,1000)): 14 jagged radial rays (5-8 segments each, seed 1337) and 2 broken concentric rings (r 120, 260), drawn over 3 frames: 2 px white core, 1 px dark edge.
- b12.0-13.0 (f144-156) ANC RING ERASE (signature): a ring spawns at the same cup point. Radius r = 2200 x ein(seg(beat,12,13)): slow, then accelerating like a shockwave, reaching the frame corners about b12.85.
  Inside r: solid ink #050506; the cheap world, the cracks and the caption pill are deleted.
  Ring stroke: 5 px #e6c896, shadowBlur 30 rgba(230,200,150,.7).
  Just outside the ring, a 36 px REFRACTION BAND: the frozen slide AND the crack lines redrawn at scale 1.035 about the ring centre, clipped to the annulus [r, r+36], so the cracks visibly bend like glass under a lens.
  HUD label riding the ring top, centred x = ring cx, y = cy - r - 30: 'ANC ON · −42 dB'. It flies off the top with the ring.
- b13.0-15.5 (f156-186) TRUE SILENCE on ink + grain. The narrator line builds word by word, centred (540,960): '...you' b13.0, 'presented' b13.5, 'it' b14.0, 'like' b14.5. Each word goes alpha 0 -> 1, blur 10 -> 0 px, y +14 -> 0 over 4 frames. b14.5-15.5: the whole line slowly pushes in (scale 1.00 -> 1.06, eio) and tracking opens 0 -> +0.04em.
- b15.5-15.92 (f186-191) INHALE: every letter lerps to (540,960) with expoIn while scaling 1 -> .05. At f191 only a tiny gold point remains (r 4 px, glow 20 px #e6c896) for 1 frame, the seed of 'THIS.' and of the ring.
scenes.typography: Ring HUD: JetBrains Mono 700 30 px #e6c896, letter-spacing .25em, 'ANC ON · −42 dB' (true minus U+2212). Narrator line: Instrument Serif italic 76 px #f6f3ec, one line '...you presented it like' (about 820 px wide), baseline y 985.
scenes.fx: b11.0: rgb .02 for 2 frames, glitch .25 (frames 0-1, glitchSeed per frame). b11.5: glitch .15 (2 frames). b11.0-11.75: scanlines .15. b12.0-13.0: bloom .6 (the ring glows), displace .006 (displaceScale 2), rgb .006. b13.0-15.5: grain .05, vignette .5, everything else default: the cleanest image so far. b15.5-16.0: zoomBlur 0 -> .4 at [.5,.5], rgb 0 -> .01. cutIn 'none'.
scenes.transitionIn: Record-scratch freeze and tape stop on the cheap slide.
scenes.transitionOut: Everything collapses into one gold point; at b16.0 the point detonates into 'THIS.'.
scenes.sound: b11.0: vinyl scratch (forward-back, 0.25 s) + TAPE STOP on the muzak bus (tape_stop, playback rate 1 -> 0 over 0.3 s, quadratic) + vinyl crackle tail. b11.75: one dry glass 'tik' (6 kHz click + short ring). b12.0-13.0: the leftover sound (tape-stop tail, crackle, faint room hum) is low-passed 8 kHz -> 40 Hz in sync with the ring radius (sweep_lp with the ein curve) under a soft downlifter whoosh, reaching EXACT digital zero at b13.0: the audience hears the ANC switch on. b13.0-15.5: TRUE DIGITAL SILENCE (samples 5.2 s - 6.2 s are zeros; no word ticks, no reverb tails). b15.5-16.0: reversed braam + reversed cymbal swell (0.2 s) sucking into b16.
scenes.implementationNotes: cutIn 'none'. Copy renderBefore from s01; each frame draw it at the remapped beat into an offscreen 1080x1920 canvas (draw cost is small), then apply the sag transform and ctx.filter 'saturate() brightness()'. Crack: deterministic polyline generator (seed 1337) drawn into the same offscreen canvas so the refraction band bends it too. Ring erase draw order: frozen canvas -> annulus clip + drawImage(frozen, scaled 1.035 about ring centre) -> fill circle ink -> stroke ring -> HUD label. Inhale: lay out the line with measure() per letter so each letter has its own x and can lerp to centre.

scenes.name: THIS. — windows, shear, and the period that draws the ring
scenes.layers: bg2d: ink #050506 and a faint warm haze. fg2d: 'THIS.' (solid, then a stencil/window, then sliced columns), the gold period, its trail and anamorphic streak. 3D (from b19.0): the right ear cup in total darkness plus an emissive tube that draws the cup's gold ring.
scenes.visual:
- b16.0 (f192) THE HIT: 'THIS.' fills the frame, cap height centred on y 960. Frames 0-2: letters arrive as horizontal slices offset +/-40 px, settled by frame 3. Scale 1.12 -> 1.0 (expoOut, 8 frames). The period is champagne gold.
- b16.5 (f198) LETTERS BECOME WINDOWS: the letters T H I S show hero.jpg (cover, zoom 2.4, panning up 120 px over the beat); ink everywhere else; each glyph keeps a 2 px #e6c896 inner edge. b17.0 (f204): window content hard-cuts to macro.jpg (zoom 3, pans left). b17.25 (f207): content cuts to the orbit sprite, frames 0 -> 39 scrubbing over 3 frames.
- b17.5 (f210) SWISS SHEAR: T H I S (not the period) is sliced into 12 vertical 90 px columns (x = i x 90). Even columns shoot up, odd shoot down, 2200 px, column i starts at f210+i and travels 8 frames (expoIn) with 3-ghost trails. Only the glowing gold period remains, at its typeset position (about (960,1120); measure it).
- b18.0-18.5 (f216-222): the period glides to (540,960) (eio) leaving an 8-ghost fading gold trail.
- b18.5 (f222) HEARTBEAT: the dot pulses, scale 1 -> 1.7 -> 1 in 6 frames.
- b18.75 (f225) ANAMORPHIC STREAK: the dot stretches horizontally to 1080 px in 3 frames: 3 px white-gold core #fff4dc, 60 px soft gold halo #e6c896.
- b19.0-19.75 (f228-237) THE STREAK BENDS INTO THE RING: the 3D layer starts: the right ear cup seen straight onto its outer face, centred (540,960), model completely black (all lights 0, envIntensity 0). An emissive tube on the centre-line of the cup's gold ring (about 640 px across on screen) draws itself from 12 o'clock in both directions and closes at 6 o'clock exactly at b19.75. During b19.0-19.1 the 2D streak ends travel along the projected circle so the handoff is seamless.
- b19.75-20.0: the closed ring glows brighter (emissive 3 -> 6), the inhale before the reveal.
scenes.typography: 'THIS.': Anton 400 auto-fitted to 980 px wide (about 540 px font), #f6f3ec, centred x 540, cap height centred on y 960. The period: champagne gold gradient (goldGrad #e6c896 -> #b8925a) with a soft glow. No other text.
scenes.fx: b16.0: flash 1.0 #f6f3ec -> 0 over 6 frames; zoom 1.12 -> 1 (8 frames); rgb .03 -> .0015 over 12 frames; zoomBlur .6 -> 0 over 6 frames; glitch .5 on frames 0-2; shake .012 uv decaying over 1 beat; bloom .7. The AFTER look (grain .05, vignette .4) switches on at f192. b16.5, b17.0, b17.25: 2-frame glitch slices + rgb kick .008 on each window cut. b17.5: zoomBlur .25, shake .006. b18.75: bloom 1.2 threshold .6 on the streak. b19.0-20.0: bloom 1.2 on the emissive ring.
scenes.transitionIn: The gold point from s02 detonates into the word: the first hit of the film.
scenes.transitionOut: Object match: the period has become the ear cup's glowing gold ring; at b20.0 light floods in on the same framing (s04).
scenes.sound: b16.0 DROP 0 / bar 1 of the AFTER grid, D minor: braam D2 (2.4 s, bright 1.0) + impact (sub 1.0, crack .8) + kick + taiko + granular glass shatter panned wide; long tail. b16.5, b17.0, b17.25: camera-shutter clicks (window cuts). b17.5: metallic 'shing' + reverse whoosh for the shear. b18.0: low drone pad Dm (D2 A2) grows from the braam tail. b18.5: heartbeat sub thump 55 Hz ('lub-dub' b18.5 + b18.75... use lub at b18.5 only, the streak 'shhwip' (bright noise swipe panned L -> R) at b18.75. b19.0-19.75: rising glass-harmonic shimmer while the ring draws; b19.75: tiny tick.
scenes.implementationNotes: cutIn 'none'. Window: offscreen canvas, drawCover(photo), globalCompositeOperation 'destination-in', fillText('THIS' without the period), blit. Shear: render T H I S to an offscreen canvas, draw 12 column slices with y offsets +/-2200 x expoIn(seg(f, 210+i, 218+i)); draw the period separately on top. Ring tube: TubeGeometry on a circle matching cup.userData.parts.ring's centre-line (world transform of hp.cups[1]); reveal with a shader uniform discarding fragments whose angle from 12 o'clock exceeds progress x pi (both sides). Lights and env must be at 0 so the rest of the model is invisible. Share camera pose constants with s04 (its first frame is this framing).

scenes.name: REVEAL — the ring calms the sound sea
scenes.layers: bg2d: ink + warm volumetric beam gradient from the top-right. 3D: the full headphone floating above the SOUND SEA (fx3d waveTerrain line grid) + 3k dust motes; shots B and C are 3D close-ups of the same model. fg2d: 'Introducing' / 'SILENCE ONE', part labels with leader lines.
scenes.visual:
SHOT A b20.0-22.0 THE REVEAL:
- b20.0 (f240) the ring flashes: emissive 6 -> 0 over 8 frames, cross-fading into the real polished champagne-gold PBR ring. Warm key #ffe2b0 from top-right ramps 0 -> 1 over 6 frames, gold rim from back-left, env .25.
- b20.0-21.0 the camera PULLS BACK fast (expoOut over 1 beat) from the cup face to a 3/4 view of the whole product, centred (540,820), about 820 px wide, with 25 deg of yaw and a rise; then a slow drift (+12 deg product rotation over b20-22, float +/-.15 units).
- Under it, the SOUND SEA: a line-grid terrain (about 110 rows x 160 points, 80 units wide), horizon near y 1180, lines #9a978f at 35% additive, displaced by fbm amplitude 2.2 rolling toward camera at 3 units/s: violent, cold, noisy.
- b20.5-22.5 the gold ANC RING expands on the sea plane from under the product, radius 0 -> 60 units (eout). Behind it the waves flatten into perfectly straight, still lines; the crests at the ring edge glow gold (#e6c896 x3). The noise visibly dies around the product.
- 3k dust motes drift in the beam.
- b21.0 'Introducing' fades in one letter per frame at (540,1430). b21.5 'SILENCE ONE' mask-wipes in under it at (540,1515).
SHOT B b22.0-23.0 HARD CUT: 3/4 macro on the right gold slider and the top of the cup. A narrow soft light sweeps left -> right across the beat, so a bright specular stripe glides along the gold and over the matte stone. Camera pushes in 6%. Label '01 / CHAMPAGNE GOLD ALUMINUM' types on at 1 char per frame from b22.25; a 1 px #b8925a leader line draws from the label to the slider over 8 frames.
SHOT C b23.0-23.5 HARD CUT: macro skim along the woven stone-grey headband (camera very close, dollying along the arc), grazing side light reveals the weave; the gold core band glints at the edge. Label '02 / WOVEN STONE FABRIC' at the same position.
b23.5-24.0 (f282-288) WHIP: camera yaw +70 deg in 6 frames with motion blur into the grid (s05).
scenes.typography: 'Introducing': Instrument Serif italic 104 px, vertical gradient #f6f3ec -> #e6c896, centred, baseline y 1430. 'SILENCE ONE': Unbounded 300 48 px #e6c896, letter-spacing .5em, centred, baseline y 1515, maskText wipe from centre over 6 frames. Part labels (left-aligned x 80): index Unbounded 300 34 px #9a978f at baseline y 1470; name JetBrains Mono 700 30 px #e6c896, letter-spacing .2em, baseline y 1520. Labels leave with a 3-frame wipe at the next cut.
scenes.fx: b20.0: flash .35 warm [1,.9,.7] -> 0 over 6 frames, bloom 1.2 -> .6 over 1 beat, zoom 1.04 -> 1. Base: exposure .8, bloom .6, grain .05, vignette .5, sat .92, rgb .0015. b22.0 and b23.0: 1-frame rgb .008 + zoom 1.04 -> 1 (3 frames). b23.5-24.0: motionBlur 4, zoomBlur .4, rgb .015.
scenes.transitionIn: Object match from the glowing ring of s03; light floods the same framing.
scenes.transitionOut: Whip pan right with motion blur; lands on the single-cell grid on the b24 downbeat.
scenes.sound: b20.0 (downbeat): ring-closing 'TING' (bell partials D5, long reverb) + sub boom. Dark pad Dm add9 (D2 A2 E3 F3). Heartbeat sub thump on every beat. b20.0-20.5 a 'world noise' bed (pink noise + distant murmur + traffic, band-pass 200-3000 Hz) at -16 dB; b20.5-22.5 it is low-passed and faded to nothing in sync with the ring radius: the audience HEARS the ANC calm the sea. b21.0: soft glock shimmer D6 + A6 under 'Introducing'. b22.0 and b23.0: light-sweep whooshes panned with the light. Closed 16th hats fade in from b22 (-30 -> -14 dB). Riser b22.0-24.0. b23.5: whip whoosh; b23.75: reverse 'suck' into b24.
scenes.implementationNotes: Sound sea: fx3d waveTerrain; update(fn(x,z)) with y = fbm(x, z - t*3) * 2.2 * smoothstep(R, R+6, hypot(x,z)), R = ring radius; colour gold near |dist - R| < 1.5 (vertex colours or a second additive line copy). Ring on the sea: thin RingGeometry, additive, colour x3. Shot B light: SpotLight (penumbra .8) or a point light moving x -2 -> +2 across the beat. Camera presets as Catmull-Rom samples by local beat. Labels: leader line target = projected slider world position (Vector3.project).

scenes.name: DROP 1 — grid multiply, stadium wave, Droste dive
scenes.layers: bg2d: all cells (orbit sprite frames via orbitFrame, macro.jpg, hero.jpg, type tiles). fg2d: 4 px gold gutters. 3D: off (saves CPU) until the swap at b28.
scenes.visual:
The frame subdivides; new gutters (4 px #e6c896 at 60%) draw on over 3 frames from the centre outward. Every orbit-sprite cell scrubs its frame in ping-pong.
- b24.0 (f288) 1 cell: orbit sprite size 1080 at (540,960) on ink; behind it a vertical ghost 'SILENCE' (rotated -90 deg) at 8%.
- b24.5 2 cells (1 col x 2 rows, 1080x960): top orbit sprite size 940 at (540,480); bottom ink cell with 'SILENCE' at baseline y 1500.
- b25.0 4 cells (2x2, 540x960): TL orbit sprite; TR ink + 'ONE' in gold gradient; BL macro.jpg cover; BR solid #e6c896 + '−42 dB' in ink.
- b25.5 8 cells (2x4, 540x480): sprite / '40 H' / sprite / '360°' / macro / '250 G' / sprite / 'ANC-H2' (type tiles alternate ink-on-gold and warm-white-on-ink).
- b26.0 16 cells (4x4, 270x480): all sprites, frame = base + 2.5 x (col+row): a diagonal rotation wave.
- b26.5 32 cells (4x8, 270x240).
- b26.75 64 cells (8x8, 135x240).
- b27.0 128 cells (8x16, 135x120): STADIUM WAVE. frame(c,r,b) = 20 + 19 x sin(2pi x 1.25 x (b-27) - .55 x (c + .6r)), a ripple of rotation sweeping bottom-left to top-right. Every 7th cell (by index) is multiplied gold #e6c896. Seven gold tiles at (c, 2c+1), c = 0..6, spell S-I-L-E-N-C-E in ink. Target cell (col 4, row 8), centre (607.5,1020), holds orbit frame 39 (front view) still.
- b27.5-28.0 (f330-336) DROSTE DIVE: the whole grid scales about the target cell 1 -> 8 (expoIn) while translating so the cell centre moves to (540,960). At f335 the cell spans 1080x960 and neighbours are smeared by zoom blur. At b28.0 it is swapped for the live 3D front view (s06).
scenes.typography: Ghost 'SILENCE' (b24): Unbounded 900 300 px #f6f3ec at 8%. 'SILENCE' (b24.5): Unbounded 900 auto-fit to 960 px (about 180 px) #f6f3ec, centred. 'ONE': Anton 400 330 px, gold gradient #e6c896 -> #b8925a. Spec tiles: Anton 400 150 px ('−42 dB', '40 H', '360°', '250 G', 'ANC-H2'). Diagonal letters: Anton 400 96 px #050506 on #e6c896. No tiny index numbers (legibility rule).
scenes.fx: Each split (b24.5, 25.0, 25.5, 26.0, 26.5, 26.75, 27.0): 1-frame gutter flash at 100% gold, 2-frame rgb .008, shake 6 px (.004 uv), zoom 1.03 -> 1 (3 frames). b24.0: punch (zoom 1.08 -> 1, rgb .02 -> .0015 over 8 frames, flash .3 white 2 frames). b27.0: 2-frame glitch .2. b27.5-28.0: zoomBlur 0 -> .5 centred on the target cell (zoomCenter [.5625,.469]), rgb 0 -> .014. Grain .05.
scenes.transitionIn: The whip pan from s04 lands on the single-cell layout on the downbeat.
scenes.transitionOut: Droste dive into one photoreal cell, match-cut to the 3D model in the same front pose.
scenes.sound: b24.0 DROP 1 (downbeat): impact + kick + crash + 808 sub-drop. Halftime luxury-trap groove in D minor: kick b24, b25.5, b26, b27.5; snare/clap on b26; 16th hats with accents; reese bass on D. Each split gets a pitched shutter/tick stab rising through the scale: D4 b24.5, E4 b25.0, F4 b25.5, G4 b26.0, A4 b26.5, Bb4 b26.75, C5 b27.0. b27.0: 1/32 hat roll. b27.5: reverse 'suck' riser into b28.
scenes.implementationNotes: Layout table: step = (b<24.5?0: b<25?1: b<25.5?2: b<26?3: b<26.5?4: b<26.75?5: b<27?6:7); dims [[1,1],[1,2],[2,2],[2,4],[4,4],[4,8],[8,8],[8,16]]. For each cell: ctx.save, clip to rect, orbitFrame(ctx,[E.img.orbit0..3], idx, cx, cy, coverSize) or drawCover. 128 drawImage calls per frame is cheap. Dive: ctx.setTransform(s,0,0,s, 540 - 607.5*s, 960 - 1020*s) with s = lerp(1,8,expoIn(seg(b,27.5,28))) (blend the translation so the cell centre reaches (540,960)). s06's 3D camera must frame the product like orbit frame 39 at about 960 px wide.

scenes.name: THE NOISE — 4 turns, 256 words, the clamp
scenes.layers: bg2d: cold haze, the back half of the noise-word storm, and from b34 the giant villain word 'NOISE' (behind the 3D product so the cups physically cover its ends). 3D: the headphone + the sound sea returning violent (cold lines). fg2d: the front half of the words, the AMBIENT NOISE dB HUD.
scenes.visual:
The only cold, desaturated stretch of the film.
- b28.0 (f336) the live 3D product in front view (match of the Droste cell), about 960 px wide, easing to 760 px by b29, centred (540,960), tilted 8 deg toward camera. Below, the sound sea is back and violent: amplitude 0.6 (b28) -> 2.8 (b34), lines cold #e9eef2 at 30%.
- SPIN b28.0-34.0: rotation.y = 8pi x ein(seg(b,28,34)): exactly 4 full turns, accelerating, slamming to a DEAD STOP front-facing at b34.0 (a hit).
- WORD STORM doubles on the beat: b28: 1, b29: 2, b30: 4, b31: 8, b32: 16, b32.5: 32, b33: 64, b33.5: 128, b34: 256 words. Instance i (rnd(i)) sets: word (50% 'NOISE', 50% from TRAFFIC, SIRENS, HONK, DRILLS, CHATTER, ALARMS, NOTIFICATIONS, +99, SUBWAY, CONSTRUCTION, JET ENGINE, OPEN OFFICE), sprite variant (solid #e9eef2, solid #9a978f, 3 px outline #9a978f, or 15% inverted ink-on-#e9eef2 box), position x 0-1080 / y 200-1720, size 30-220 px (later instances smaller, big rare), rotation {0, 90, -90, +/-6 deg}, alpha .3-.9, layer (even = bg behind the product, odd = fg in front). New words pop (scale 1.3 -> 1 over 3 frames). From b32 words jitter +/-8 px every 3 frames; from b33 alpha strobes 1 <-> .6 every 3 frames.
- HUD (fg): 'AMBIENT NOISE' label; counter climbing 38 -> 118 dB (integer, ein); a meter bar 0 -> 920 px wide at y 400, cold white with a jittering edge.
- b34.0-35.5 THE PUSH: the giant villain 'NOISE' appears between the cups (bg2d, centred (540,1000)), trembling (+/-10 px, +/-4 deg per frame, R/B ghost copies offset +/-8 px) and growing, as if it shoves the headphone apart: cups slide from x +/-base to +/-1.55 x base (eout), sliders follow the cups, band.scale.x 1 -> 1.55. Cups tremble +/-.08 units per frame.
- b35.5-36.0 (f426-432) THE CLAMP: the cups slam inward to +/-base (back-in ease, hard stop exactly at f432). 'NOISE' scaleX follows the projected gap between the cups' inner faces (1 -> .015) while scaleY stretches 1 -> 1.15: squash into a vertical hairline. All storm words are sucked toward (540,1000), shrinking to 0 (expoIn). The meter flickers at 118.
- At f431 the crushed word is a 6 px white line between the cups; s07 opens on the click.
scenes.typography: Words: Anton 400 (60%), JetBrains Mono 700 (25%), Inter 900 (15%), uppercase, sprites pre-rendered at 400 px font and scaled (never below 30 px on screen). Villain 'NOISE': Anton 400 290 px #f6f3ec with R (#ff4040) / B (#4060ff) ghosts at 50%. HUD: 'AMBIENT NOISE' JetBrains Mono 700 30 px #9a978f, letter-spacing .2em, left-aligned at (80,262); counter Anton 400 96 px #e9eef2 left-aligned baseline (80,360) followed by 'dB' Unbounded 500 40 px #e6c896.
scenes.fx: Grade: sat .3, tint [.92,.96,1.04], contrast 1.05 (cold); bloom .45 so only the gold rings glow. Every beat: zoom 1.03 punch (4 frames) + rgb kick .005. b28.0: punch (flash .25 white 2 frames). b30-34: rgb .003 -> .02 (ein), grain .05 -> .3, scanlines 0 -> .35. b32-34: glitch .05 -> .4, glitchSeed changing every 3 frames; motionBlur 2 from b32, 4 from b33 (the spin becomes a blur); pixelate 24 px for 1 frame at b33.0 and b34.0. b34.0: shake .012 decaying 8 frames. b34-35.5: displace .01 on the whole frame, continuous shake .003. b35.5-36.0: zoomBlur 0 -> .3 toward the centre, glitch fading to 0.
scenes.transitionIn: Match cut from the Droste-dive cell (orbit frame 39) to the 3D front view.
scenes.transitionOut: Continuous into s07: the clamp locks at b36.0 and the same pose detonates.
scenes.sound: PRESSURE in D minor -> A (dominant). 4/4 kick, reese bass on 8ths (D1+D2), snare density doubling: quarters on beats 2 and 4 (b28-32), 8ths (b32-33), 16ths (b33-34). A synthesized WORLD NOISE layer (traffic rumble, sirens as crossing sine sweeps 600-1200 Hz, square-wave car horns, jackhammer 16ths, notification pings, crowd babble) swells +18 dB from b28 to b34, multiplying with the words. A short pitched-up glitch_burst on each doubling: b29, b30, b31, b32, b32.5, b33, b33.5. Riser b28-34. b34.0: the spin stops on a metallic 'CHUNK' + tom. b34.0-35.5: everything pitched down and squeezed with a creaking 'rubber stretch'. b35.5-36.0: master low-pass sweeps 16 kHz -> 60 Hz (exponential) with heavy pumping compression.
scenes.implementationNotes: Model: hp.cups[0|1].position.x for the push/clamp; move hp.sliders[0|1] by the same delta and scale hp.band.sleeve/core on x so nothing detaches. NOISE gap: project the cups' inner faces each frame (Vector3.project) to get the screen gap; scaleX = gap(t)/gap(b34). Pre-render the word sprites in init (about 40 canvases); 256 drawImage calls per frame. Sound sea: same waveTerrain module as s04 with cold colour. Export the end pose (cups at base, rotation 8pi, word table) so s07 rebuilds the exact b36 frame.

scenes.name: THE MUTE — frozen explosion, −42 dB
scenes.layers: bg2d: ink, the blasted-then-frozen noise words, slow 2D parallax. 3D: the exploded product (sleeve, core, sliders, both cups' 9 layers each) + 100k debris particles from hp.sample. fg2d: the gold freeze ring, the dB counter that dives and becomes '−42 dB', the poetic line, 'ANC ● ON'.
scenes.visual:
- b36.0 (f432) CLICK + DETONATION: the crushed hairline flashes gold for 1 frame, then the product detonates: hp.explode(1) and explodeCup(both cups, 1) driven by u = expoOut over 0.1 s; every part flies out along its explode direction to explodeOffset x (1 + 10u) and tumbles (random axis, up to 40 deg per frame); 100k points blast outward at 15-60 units/s; the sucked-in noise words reverse and blast outward.
- b36.25 (f435) ANC FREEZE: a perfect thin gold circle spawns at (540,960) and expands to r 1400 in 4 frames. Everything freezes where the ring passes (centre first, edges a frame later). The 2D words freeze the same way.
- THE dB DIVE, on 1/16 steps, centred (540,930): b36.25 '118' (the HUD counter jumps to centre, huge) -> b36.5 '64' -> b36.75 '11' -> b37.0 '−42 dB'. Each value rolls in like a slot machine (3 frames). Simultaneously the FX switch off one per step (see fx) and the colour drains (sat -> .12, cool tint): the image visibly 'goes quiet'. At b37.0 the brutal Anton numerals cross-dissolve (4 frames) into the hairline serif '−42 dB'.
- b37.0-39.0 BULLET TIME IN SILENCE: everything hangs mid-air: stone shell, gold rings, the green PCB with gold traces and 'SILENCE ONE · ANC-H2' print, the 'SILENCE CELL' battery, magnet, copper coil, titanium diaphragms, mesh, cushions, sliders, fabric sleeve, 100k particles like a galaxy of dust. ONLY THE CAMERA MOVES (eio over b36.6-39.5): a slow dolly 35% deeper into the debris, 28 deg orbit, 3 deg roll; near particles slide past the lens with parallax. A cold key light glides across the frozen parts and catches metal edges one by one. Letterbox slides in.
- b37.0 'ANC ● ON' at (540,300). b37.75 'the world, on mute.' fades in at (540,1100) over 1 beat. '−42 dB' drifts +1.5% in scale.
- b39.0-39.5 TENSION: the frozen debris trembles (jitter 0 -> .12 units, deterministic per part at 30 Hz); text trembles 0 -> 2 px; sat .12 -> .3.
- b39.5-40.0 (f474-480) REWIND-SNAP: explosion progress runs backward to 0 (expoIn, 6 frames); every piece and particle rushes back into the assembled product; text collapses to the centre; words rush in and vanish; the gold ring contracts r 1400 -> 0; letterbox snaps open at f478. At f480 the product is whole and front-facing.
scenes.typography: Dive numerals: Anton 400 300 px #f6f3ec, centred (540,930). Final '−42 dB': Instrument Serif 400 (roman) 240 px #f6f3ec, true minus U+2212. 'the world, on mute.': Instrument Serif italic 58 px #9a978f, centred, baseline y 1100. 'ANC ● ON': JetBrains Mono 700 30 px #e6c896, letter-spacing .35em, centred (540,300); the dot is a static 10 px gold circle.
scenes.fx: b36.0 (f432-434): flash .9 white, zoom 1.12, rgb .03, shake .015, zoomBlur .6, glitch .4. Step-down: b36.25 glitch 0, shake 0, zoom 1; b36.5 rgb .001, zoomBlur 0; b36.75 sat .12, tint [.92,.96,1.04], bloom .3, contrast 1.1; b37.0 only grain .06 (still moving, the only 'alive' texture) and vignette .55 remain. Letterbox 0 -> .07 over b37.0-37.5. b39.5-40.0: zoomBlur 0 -> .7, rgb 0 -> .025, motionBlur 4, sat -> 1, letterbox -> 0. cutIn 'none'.
scenes.transitionIn: Continuous from s06: the clamped pose detonates on the click.
scenes.transitionOut: Rewind-snap: all debris converges into the assembled product exactly on the DROP 2 downbeat (b40.0).
scenes.sound: b36.0 (downbeat): crisp mechanical CLICK (3 kHz latch transient + 120 Hz thump) and, on the same sample, impact + crash + braam starting. The roar is gated DOWN in 1/16 steps matching the counter: b36.25 -18 dB, b36.5 -36 dB + low-pass 2 kHz, b36.75 -54 dB + low-pass 300 Hz, b37.0 EXACT ZERO. b37.0-39.5: TRUE DIGITAL SILENCE, 1.0 s (14.8 s - 15.8 s); every reverb/delay tail killed, applied after the limiter. b39.5-40.0: reverse cymbal + reversed impact + reversed braam swelling and sucking into the drop.
scenes.implementationNotes: cutIn 'none'. Explosion is a pure function: tEff = min(t, tF + d/v) with tF = b2s(36.25), d = part's screen distance from centre, v = 1400 px per 4 frames; offset = explodeOffset x (1 + 10 x expoOut((tEff - b2s(36))/0.1)); during b39.5-40 multiply progress by (1 - expoIn(seg(b,39.5,40))). Particles: one THREE.Points with a ShaderMaterial, position = base + dir x speed x tEffPerVertex (uniforms uT, uTF, uRingV, uRewind); no CPU loops. Rebuild the s06 b36 state from shared constants; the b40 end pose must equal s08's start. Budget: one model + 100k points.

scenes.name: DROP 2 — the 360° type gyroscope
scenes.layers: bg2d: radial warm glow + a giant slowly rotating '360°'. 3D: the solid headphone and three counter-rotating text rings (fx3d textRing) with true depth occlusion. fg2d: live yaw readout + compass strip.
scenes.visual:
- b40.0 (f480) DROP 2: the reassembled product, front-facing, about 880 px wide, centred (540,980). Gold rings flare emissive x4 and decay over 1 beat. THE GYROSCOPE snaps open around it, one ring per 1/8 (scale 0 -> 1, back easing, 6 frames):
  b40.0 Ring A: radius 13 units, tilted 70 deg on X (a Saturn ring), '360° SPATIAL AUDIO · ' in warm white HDR (x2), spinning +90 deg/s.
  b40.5 Ring B: radius 14.5, tilted 20 deg on Z (near vertical), 'SILENCE ONE · ' in gold, spinning -120 deg/s.
  b41.0 Ring C: radius 16, tilted -45 deg, '40 H · −42 dB · 250 G · 40 MM · ANC-H2 · ' in mono, spinning +60 deg/s.
  Every downbeat gives each ring a spin impulse. Rings pass in front of and behind the product with true depth; back faces at 35%.
- CAMERA b40-44: a 180-deg-per-bar orbit with a SPEED RAMP: b40.0-40.5 whip 120 deg (expoIO, motionBlur 4), b40.5-44.0 slow glide of 60 deg. Gentle crane up.
- b44.0-46.0 HARD CUTS every 1/8 between 4 presets while the rings keep spinning: b44.0 top-down (the rings become concentric circles like a target); b44.5 low-angle hero; b45.0 macro on the gold ear-cup ring with type streaking past the lens; b45.5 wide. Then repeat the four presets mirrored in angle at b46.0... no: at b46.0 return to the orbit.
- b46.0-47.5: orbit resumes (another 120 deg whip at b46.0 then glide). Rings tighten, radii shrinking to hug the product (13/14.5/16 -> 10.5/11.5/12.5) while spin speed triples.
- b47.5-48.0 (f570-576): the camera RUSHES into the right cup's acoustic mesh (dolly, expoIn, motionBlur 3); at f575 the dark dot pattern fills the frame.
scenes.typography: Ring A: Unbounded 900 canvas texture (120 px cap height) #f6f3ec. Ring B: Anton 400, gold gradient #e6c896 -> #b8925a. Ring C: JetBrains Mono 700, #e6c896. bg2d: '360°' Anton 400 760 px #f6f3ec at 9%, centred (540,960), rotating -6 deg/s. fg2d: 'θ 000°' JetBrains Mono 700 64 px #f6f3ec left-aligned at (80,1560), counting the live camera yaw (fixed-width digits); under it 'SPATIAL AUDIO · HEAD-TRACKED' JetBrains Mono 400 30 px #9a978f at (80,1610). Top-right: a compass strip (tick marks every 15 deg, 2 px #e6c896) scrolling with the yaw at y 250, x 640-1000.
scenes.fx: b40.0: flash .85 gold [1,.82,.55] -> 0 over 9 frames; zoom 1.18 -> 1 (expoOut, 8 frames); rgb .035 -> .002 over 1 beat; zoomBlur .8 -> 0 over 6 frames; shake .012 decaying 1 beat. Then sat 1.1, contrast 1.08, bloom .9, bloomThreshold .6, grain .045, vignette .4. Every kick: zoom 1.02 + rgb .006 (4 frames). Whip segments: motionBlur 4. b44-46 cuts: 2-frame glitch slices .25 + 1-frame rgb .015 + shake .006 on each cut. b46.0: second whip. b47-47.75: rgb pulses .01 on every 1/16. b47.5-48.0: zoomBlur 0 -> .8, motionBlur 3.
scenes.transitionIn: Rewind-snap from the frozen explosion; the drop lands on the reassembly.
scenes.transitionOut: Dolly into the acoustic mesh; its dot pattern match-cuts into the corridor of s09.
scenes.sound: b40.0 DROP 2, the loudest moment: impact (sub 1.2, crack 1.0) + kick + crash + braam D2 + supersaw Dm9 stab. Full groove: 4/4 kick, clap on b41, 43, 45, 47; 16th hats with open hats on off-beats; sub808 D1 jumping octaves on 8ths with sidechain pump; supersaw lead hook D5-F5-A5-C6 over a 2-bar phrase. Ring snaps b40.0, b40.5, b41.0: three metallic 'shing' hits pitched up. SPATIAL NOD: hats, ride and the arp auto-pan in a full circle phase-locked to the camera yaw (pan = sin(yaw)), with a slight low-pass when 'behind'. b40.0 and b46.0: whip whooshes. b44.0, 44.5, 45.0, 45.5: stutter-gated hits on each cut. b46-47.5: rising tom fill. b47.5: whoosh up into the mesh + reverse cymbal.
scenes.implementationNotes: Rings: fx3d textRing with opts for radius/height; add the product first so depth gives correct occlusion; back faces via a second mesh (side BackSide, opacity .35). Camera yaw(b): per 6-beat bar segment, yaw += 120 x expoIO(seg(b, b0, b0+.5)) + 60 x seg(b, b0+.5, b0+4). Cut presets: table [{pos, target, fov}] chosen by floor((b-44)*2). Export yaw(b) as JSON per frame for sound.py's pan law. Mesh rush: camera lerps toward hp.cups[1] world position along its outward axis, ending inside the mesh disc at f575.

scenes.name: GATE RUN — wearing the corridor
scenes.layers: bg2d: ink + gold vanishing-point glow. 3D: a corridor of headphone instances used as gates + fx3d streaks (300 additive light streaks). fg2d: rolling spec numbers with serif descriptors, framed by the gates.
scenes.visual:
- b48.0 (f576) match cut from the mesh: the dot pattern scales out over 3 frames, revealing we are flying down a corridor.
- GATES: headphone instances every 24 units along -Z, scaled so the camera path passes UNDER the headband and BETWEEN the cups, like a head putting them on. Alternate gates rotate 0 / 90 / 180 / 270 deg about Z.
- CAMERA: -Z at a constant 24 units per beat, so a gate sweeps past the lens EXACTLY on every beat (b49, 50, ... 55, and b56 is the exit). It rolls continuously 0 -> 180 deg over b48-56: the corridor spirals. A point light travels with the camera so each gate's gold rings flare as it passes; gates alternate warm-gold and cool stone-grey lighting.
- STREAKS: 300 thin additive streaks (#e6c896 and white) race along the walls.
- bg: radial gold glow at the vanishing point (540,900), r 400, rgba(230,200,150,.18).
- SPEC SLAMS centred on the vanishing point: b48.0 '40' + 'h' / 'of battery'; b50.0 '40' + 'mm' / 'titanium driver'; b52.0 '250' + 'g' / 'of almost nothing'; b54.0 '360' + '°' / 'spatial audio'. Each runs: +0 digits roll like a slot machine (each column cycles 0-9 in a mask, resolving left -> right over 6 frames) while the block slams in (scale 1.4 -> 1, 3 frames, expoOut) with glitch slices; +0.5 the serif line reveals letter by letter (1-frame stagger, blur 10 -> 0); +1.0 the number stutters (duplicate offset +18 px at alpha .4, flashed twice on 16ths); +1.75 the whole spec wipes out with a 3-frame horizontal slice displacement.
scenes.typography: Numbers: Anton 400 420 px #f6f3ec, centred around x 500, baseline y 1020. Units 'h' / 'mm' / 'g' / '°': Unbounded 700 110 px in the gold gradient, set right after the number on the same baseline. Descriptors: Instrument Serif italic 76 px #f6f3ec, centred, baseline y 1200. Brutal Anton numbers paired with elegant serif captions.
scenes.fx: Each gate pass (b49-56): flash .15 white (3 frames), rgb kick .012, zoom 1.04 punch. Constant zoomBlur .15 for speed; motionBlur 2 throughout. Spec slams b48, 50, 52, 54: zoom 1.06, glitch .3 (3 frames). bloom .8, sat 1.1, grain .04, vignette .4. b55-56: zoomBlur rising .15 -> .35.
scenes.transitionIn: Match cut from the acoustic-mesh dots to the corridor.
scenes.transitionOut: The camera bursts out of the last gate at b56.0 into open dark space (s10).
scenes.sound: Groove continues (kick, sub, claps, hats, hook). THE STAIRCASE: each gate pass (b49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56) gets a short whoosh landing ON the beat, panned alternately L/R and tuned to the next note of D minor: D4 E4 F4 G4 A4 Bb4 C5 D5, eight audible steps. Spec slams b48, 50, 52, 54: heavy slam (snare + short impact + sub drop) + a 6-frame 'counter rattle' (rapid ticks). Each serif line: soft shimmer. Lead hook up an octave from b52. b55-56: riser + 16th snare into b56.
scenes.implementationNotes: Budget: at most 6 createHeadphone() instances recycled (z modulo 6 x 24 ahead of the camera); if a frame exceeds 2.5 s drop to 4 instances + fog to ink. scene.userData.envIntensity .35, no shadows. Gate k sits at camera.z at beat 49 + k. Camera roll via camera.rotation.z. Streaks: fx3d streaks(300).update(time, speed). Slot-machine digits: per column, draw digits stacked in a clipped rect with offset = (target + 10 x (1 - eout(p))) mod 10.

scenes.name: PEAK — particle bloom, cut cascade, 'Hear nothing.'
scenes.layers: bg2d: ink, full-frame photos and colour cards in the cascade, the 'Hear nothing.' card. 3D: 150k-particle product (fx3d morphPoints) + the violent sound sea; 3D cascade shots. fg2d: cascade typography.
scenes.visual:
PART 1 PARTICLE BLOOM b56.0-59.0:
- b56.0 (f672) burst out of the last gate into open dark space; camera whip pull-back (b56.0-56.5, motionBlur 3). 150k points with the model's colours (gold where gold, stone, charcoal) start scattered (sample + random dir x 30) and ASSEMBLE into the product over b56.0-56.75 (expoOut, per-point delay). Product centred (540,900), about 900 px wide, slow orbit.
- b57.0 BREATH: the cloud scales 1 -> 1.25 over 6 frames and snaps back by b57.5 (expoIn).
- b58.0 TWIST: the cloud snaps +35 deg around Y in 3 frames and springs back over 6.
- b58.5 SHIMMER: a scatter pulse (.8 -> 0 over 6 frames) ripples through the points; the real mesh fades in inside them (setOpacity 0 -> 1 by b59.0); points remain as a glowing aura.
- Underneath, the sound sea returns VIOLENT in gold: amplitude 4.5, every kick launches a ring-shaped swell from under the product.
PART 2 CUT CASCADE b59.0-62.0 (photosensitivity-safe: only ONE large bright field):
8ths: b59.0 macro.jpg full-bleed (drawCover zoom 1.2 -> 1.3, liquid displace .04); b59.5 3D extreme close-up grazing along the gold slider and the woven sleeve (camera tracking sideways fast, light streak); b60.0 orbit sprite frame 30 at size 1300 with mirror FX 1 (a symmetrical 'double headphone'), warm tint; b60.5 hero.jpg drawCover zoom 1.4, rgb .025, zoomBlur .3.
16ths: b61.0 'SILENCE' card, ink on solid #e6c896 (the single bright field); b61.25 3D product front-on, rim-lit on ink; b61.5 'ONE' gold on ink; b61.75 orbit frame 10 on ink with '−42 dB' overlaid.
PART 3 b62.0-64.0 'HEAR NOTHING.': hard cut to pure ink #050506. 'Hear nothing.' appears instantly at (540,960). Only grain and an imperceptible push (scale 1.00 -> 1.03) move. The score is still playing, but muffled, as if heard through the ANC.
scenes.typography: 'SILENCE' card: Anton 400 auto-fit to 1000 px, #050506 on #e6c896. 'ONE' card: Anton 400 auto-fit to 900 px, gold gradient on #050506. '−42 dB' overlay: Anton 400 200 px #f6f3ec centred (540,1450). 'Hear nothing.': Instrument Serif italic 120 px #f6f3ec, centred, baseline y 990.
scenes.fx: b56.0: flash .5 gold [1,.82,.55] 4 frames, zoomBlur .6 -> 0, motionBlur 3 (b56.0-56.5 only). b56-59: bloom 1.0 (threshold .55); every kick zoom 1.03 + rgb .008; b57.0 and b58.0 rgb .015 kicks. Cascade: every cut a 1-frame rgb .02 kick + zoom 1.04 -> 1; mirror 1 ONLY on b60.0-60.5; displace .04 only on b59.0-59.5. No invert anywhere. b62.0-64.0: defaults except grain .05, vignette .5, bloom 0, rgb 0: the cleanest frame since the mute.
scenes.transitionIn: Burst out of the last gate; particles assemble the product.
scenes.transitionOut: From the muffled 'Hear nothing.' card, the hero lockup crashes in on b64 with 'Feel everything.'
scenes.sound: b56.0 (downbeat): exit whoosh + impact; groove at full power + a new 16th supersaw arpeggio (D minor) with heavy sidechain pump. Designed hits: b57.0 sub 'whomp' (breath), b58.0 stutter (twist), b58.5 laser filter sweep (shimmer). Cascade b59-61: one-shot ON each 8th cut (camera shutter b59.0, metal ting b59.5, bass hit b60.0, tape flick b60.5). b61-62: 16th snare fill pitched up + the whole mix gated into a 32nd-note stutter rising in pitch. b62.0-64.0 THE MUFFLE: the music bus continues but is low-passed to about 350 Hz and ducked 12 dB (heartbeat kicks b62, b63 felt more than heard); a clean high pad D6 + A6 floats above it. b63.75-64.0: a reversed 'inhale' of air.
scenes.implementationNotes: Particles: morphPoints(150000); setA(scattered), setB(hp.sample(150000)); update({mix: expoOut(seg(b,56,56.75)), scatter, time}); breath via points.scale, twist via points.rotation.y. Cascade is a shot table [{from, to, draw}]; each frame draws only ONE shot; 3D shots reuse the bloom scene with a different camera/visibility. Post knobs (mirror, displace) are per frame so they reset automatically. globalStyle:
ONE DEVICE: the ANC RING, a hairline champagne-gold circle: 5 px stroke #e6c896, shadowBlur 30 rgba(230,200,150,.7), with a 36-40 px refraction band just outside it (the content behind redrawn at scale 1.035-1.04, clipped to the annulus) and optionally a mono HUD label riding its top. It appears at b12 (erases the slide), b19 (drawn by the period as the cup's ring), b20.5 (calms the sound sea, on the 3D plane), b36.25 (freezes the explosion), b68.5 (erases the lockup) and b70 (turns into the LUMARC gradient ring and the logo halo). Every scene author should draw it the same way. Secondary motifs: the gold period/dot (b15.9-19); the SOUND SEA line terrain (s04 turbulent then calmed, s06 cold and violent, s10 gold and violent, s11 flat calm horizon); brutal Anton numbers paired with Instrument Serif lines.
PALETTES. BEFORE: cheap PowerPoint (white/light-blue gradients, #ff2b2b, #ffe600, rainbow WordArt, green bevel button), Comic Neue only, flat, no post FX. AFTER: ink #050506, champagne gold #e6c896 / #b8925a (gradient via goldGrad), warm white #f6f3ec, muted #9a978f. The only cold stretch is s06 THE NOISE (#e9eef2 + greys, sat .3, cool tint) and the step-down of s07 (sat .12). The LUMARC gradient #4f6bff -> #6a55ff -> #9a4dff appears only from b69 (ring colour crossfade); end-card colours #0e0e14 bg, #faf9f6 white, #a6a6b8 muted.
TYPE SYSTEM. Comic Neue 700: BEFORE only. Instrument Serif (italic for emotion, roman for the '−42 dB' hairline): the narrator, 'Introducing', descriptors, 'Hear nothing. / Feel everything.'. Anton 400: brutal slams and numbers (THIS., NOISE, spec numerals, grid tiles). Unbounded 300/500/700/800/900: monumental words, units, wordmark, price. JetBrains Mono 400/700: HUD and labels (always >= 30 px). Inter: only inside the noise storm. Outfit: LUMARC end card only. Minimum on-screen text 30 px; key copy inside x 80-1000, y 220-1640.
POST LEVELS (E.fx). AFTER default: exposure .85-.9, bloom .6 (threshold .72), grain .045-.05, vignette .4, rgb .0015, sat 1.0-1.1. Standard DOWNBEAT PUNCH: flash .3-.9 (white or gold [1,.82,.55]) over 2-9 frames, zoom 1.08-1.18 -> 1 (expoOut, 8 frames), rgb .02-.035 -> .0015 over 8-12 frames, zoomBlur .5-.8 -> 0 over 6 frames, shake .008-.015 uv decaying over 6-12 frames. Every kick in groove sections: zoom 1.02-1.03 + rgb .005-.006 over 4 frames. Calm/silence moments: everything off except grain .05-.06 and vignette .5-.55 (and a letterbox .07 only in s07). motionBlur 2-4 only on whips, the spin blur and rushes. Never invert-strobe: at most 3 large-area luminance flips per second.
HOW CUTS ARE HIDDEN. Object matches: the gold point -> 'THIS.'; the period -> ear-cup ring; the Droste cell (orbit frame 39) -> 3D front view; the clamp -> detonation -> freeze -> rewind-snap into the drop; the acoustic-mesh dots -> the corridor; the ANC ring -> LUMARC ring -> logo halo. Otherwise: whip pans with motion blur, a 1-frame flash or rgb kick on the cut frame, 2-frame glitch slices on 1/16 cuts. Every cut and hit lands on the beat grid (1/8 = 6 frames, 1/16 = 3 frames), and every major hit lands on a bar downbeat (16, 20, 24, ... 84). SOUND RULE: the silences (b13.0-15.5 and b37.0-39.5) are exact zeros, applied as a mask after the glue compressor and limiter; the third 'silence' (b62-64) is heard as a 350 Hz low-pass muffle that rips open on b64.
